verses.original: הַדָּבָר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר חָזָ֔ה יְשַֽׁעְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־ אָמ֑וֹץ עַל־ יְהוּדָ֖ה וִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer ḥā·zāh yə·ša‘·yā·hū ben- ’ā·mō·wṣ ‘al- yə·hū·ḏāh wî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: This is the message that was revealed to Isaiah son of Amoz concerning Judah and Jerusalem

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה׀ בְּאַחֲרִ֣ית הַיָּמִ֗ים נָכ֨וֹן יִֽהְיֶ֜ה הַ֤ר בֵּית־ יְהוָה֙ בְּרֹ֣אשׁ הֶהָרִ֔ים וְנִשָּׂ֖א מִגְּבָע֑וֹת וְנָהֲר֥וּ אֵלָ֖יו כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm nā·ḵō·wn yih·yeh har bêṯ- Yah·weh bə·rōš he·hā·rîm wə·niś·śā mig·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ wə·nā·hă·rū ’ê·lāw kāl- hag·gō·w·yim
verses.literal: In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established . . . as the chief of the mountains it will be raised above the hills and all nations will stream to it

verses.original: וְֽהָלְכ֞וּ עַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֗ים וְאָמְרוּ֙ לְכ֣וּ׀ וְנַעֲלֶ֣ה אֶל־ הַר־ יְהוָ֗ה אֶל־ בֵּית֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֔ב וְיֹרֵ֙נוּ֙ מִדְּרָכָ֔יו וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּאֹרְחֹתָ֑יו כִּ֤י מִצִּיּוֹן֙ תֵּצֵ֣א תוֹרָ֔ה וּדְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה מִירוּשָׁלִָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·lə·ḵū ‘am·mîm rab·bîm wə·’ā·mə·rū lə·ḵū wə·na·‘ă·leh ’el- har- Yah·weh ’el- bêṯ ’ĕ·lō·hê ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·yō·rê·nū mid·də·rā·ḵāw wə·nê·lə·ḵāh bə·’ō·rə·ḥō·ṯāw kî miṣ·ṣî·yō·wn tê·ṣê ṯō·w·rāh ū·ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh mî·rū·šā·lim
verses.literal: And many peoples will come and say Come let us go up to the mountain of the LORD to the house of the God of Jacob He will teach us His ways so that we may walk in His paths For the law will go forth from Zion and the word of the LORD from Jerusalem

verses.original: וְשָׁפַט֙ בֵּ֣ין הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וְהוֹכִ֖יחַ לְעַמִּ֣ים רַבִּ֑ים וְכִתְּת֨וּ חַרְבוֹתָ֜ם לְאִתִּ֗ים וַחֲנִיתֽוֹתֵיהֶם֙ לְמַזְמֵר֔וֹת לֹא־ יִשָּׂ֨א ג֤וֹי אֶל־ גּוֹי֙ חֶ֔רֶב וְלֹא־ יִלְמְד֥וּ ע֖וֹד מִלְחָמָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·p̄aṭ bên hag·gō·w·yim wə·hō·w·ḵî·aḥ lə·‘am·mîm rab·bîm wə·ḵit·tə·ṯū ḥar·ḇō·w·ṯām lə·’it·tîm wa·ḥă·nî·ṯō·w·ṯê·hem lə·maz·mê·rō·wṯ lō- yiś·śā ḡō·w ’el- gō·w ḥe·reḇ wə·lō- yil·mə·ḏū ‘ō·wḏ mil·ḥā·māh
verses.literal: Then He will judge between the nations and arbitrate for many peoples They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks Nation will no longer take up the sword against nation nor train anymore for war

verses.original: בֵּ֖ית יַעֲקֹ֑ב לְכ֥וּ וְנֵלְכָ֖ה בְּא֥וֹר יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ lə·ḵū wə·nê·lə·ḵāh bə·’ō·wr Yah·weh
verses.literal: Come O house of Jacob let us walk in the light of the LORD

verses.original: כִּ֣י נָטַ֗שְׁתָּה עַמְּךָ֙ בֵּ֣ית יַעֲקֹ֔ב כִּ֤י מָלְאוּ֙ מִקֶּ֔דֶם וְעֹֽנְנִ֖ים כַּפְּלִשְׁתִּ֑ים וּבְיַלְדֵ֥י נָכְרִ֖ים יַשְׂפִּֽיקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî nā·ṭaš·tāh ‘am·mə·ḵā bêṯ ya·‘ă·qōḇ kî mā·lə·’ū miq·qe·ḏem wə·‘ō·nə·nîm kap·pə·liš·tîm ū·ḇə·yal·ḏê nā·ḵə·rîm yaś·pî·qū
verses.literal: For You have abandoned Your people the house of Jacob because they are filled with influences from the east they are soothsayers like the Philistines they strike hands with the children of foreigners

verses.original: וַתִּמָּלֵ֤א אַרְצוֹ֙ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֔ב וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֖צֶה לְאֹצְרֹתָ֑יו וַתִּמָּלֵ֤א אַרְצוֹ֙ סוּסִ֔ים וְאֵ֥ין קֵ֖צֶה לְמַרְכְּבֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tim·mā·lê ’ar·ṣōw ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ wə·’ên qê·ṣeh lə·’ō·ṣə·rō·ṯāw wat·tim·mā·lê ’ar·ṣōw sū·sîm wə·’ên qê·ṣeh lə·mar·kə·ḇō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Their land is full of silver and gold with no limit to their treasures their land is full of horses with no limit to their chariots

verses.original: וַתִּמָּלֵ֥א אַרְצ֖וֹ אֱלִילִ֑ים לְמַעֲשֵׂ֤ה יָדָיו֙ יִֽשְׁתַּחֲו֔וּ לַאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשׂ֖וּ אֶצְבְּעֹתָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: wat·tim·mā·lê ’ar·ṣōw ’ĕ·lî·lîm lə·ma·‘ă·śêh yā·ḏāw yiš·ta·ḥă·wū la·’ă·šer ‘ā·śū ’eṣ·bə·‘ō·ṯāw
verses.literal: Their land is full of idols they bow down to the work of their hands to what their fingers have made

verses.original: וַיִּשַּׁ֥ח אָדָ֖ם וַיִּשְׁפַּל־ אִ֑ישׁ וְאַל־ תִּשָּׂ֖א לָהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·šaḥ ’ā·ḏām way·yiš·pal- ’îš wə·’al- tiś·śā lā·hem
verses.literal: So mankind is brought low and man is humbled do not forgive them

verses.original: בּ֣וֹא בַצּ֔וּר וְהִטָּמֵ֖ן בֶּֽעָפָ֑ר מִפְּנֵי֙ פַּ֣חַד יְהוָ֔ה וּמֵהֲדַ֖ר גְּאֹנֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: bō·w ḇaṣ·ṣūr wə·hiṭ·ṭā·mên be·‘ā·p̄ār mip·pə·nê pa·ḥaḏ Yah·weh ū·mê·hă·ḏar gə·’ō·nōw
verses.literal: Go into the rocks and hide in the dust from the terror of the LORD and the splendor of His majesty

verses.original: עֵינֵ֞י גַּבְה֤וּת אָדָם֙ שָׁפֵ֔ל וְשַׁ֖ח ר֣וּם אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְנִשְׂגַּ֧ב יְהוָ֛ה לְבַדּ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃ס
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·nê gaḇ·hūṯ ’ā·ḏām šā·p̄êl wə·šaḥ rūm ’ă·nā·šîm wə·niś·gaḇ Yah·weh lə·ḇad·dōw bay·yō·wm ha·hū
verses.literal: The proud look of man will be humbled and the loftiness of men brought low the LORD alone will be exalted in that day

verses.original: כִּ֣י י֞וֹם לַיהוָ֧ה צְבָא֛וֹת עַ֥ל כָּל־ גֵּאֶ֖ה וָרָ֑ם וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ נִשָּׂ֥א וְשָׁפֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: kî yō·wm Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ ‘al kāl- gê·’eh wā·rām wə·‘al kāl- niś·śā wə·šā·p̄êl
verses.literal: For the Day of the LORD of Hosts will come against all the proud and lofty against all that is exalted it will be humbled

verses.original: וְעַל֙ כָּל־ אַרְזֵ֣י הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן הָרָמִ֖ים וְהַנִּשָּׂאִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ אַלּוֹנֵ֥י הַבָּשָֽׁן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al kāl- ’ar·zê hal·lə·ḇā·nō·wn hā·rā·mîm wə·han·niś·śā·’îm wə·‘al kāl- ’al·lō·w·nê hab·bā·šān
verses.literal: against all the cedars of Lebanon lofty and lifted up against all the oaks of Bashan

verses.original: וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ הֶהָרִ֣ים הָרָמִ֑ים וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ הַגְּבָע֥וֹת הַנִּשָּׂאֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al kāl- he·hā·rîm hā·rā·mîm wə·‘al kāl- hag·gə·ḇā·‘ō·wṯ han·niś·śā·’ō·wṯ
verses.literal: against all the tall mountains against all the high hills

verses.original: וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ מִגְדָּ֣ל גָּבֹ֑הַ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ חוֹמָ֥ה בְצוּרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al kāl- miḡ·dāl gå̄·ḇō·ha wə·‘al kāl- ḥō·w·māh ḇə·ṣū·rāh
verses.literal: against every high tower against every fortified wall

verses.original: וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ אֳנִיּ֣וֹת תַּרְשִׁ֑ישׁ וְעַ֖ל כָּל־ שְׂכִיּ֥וֹת הַחֶמְדָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘al kāl- ’o·nî·yō·wṯ tar·šîš wə·‘al kāl- śə·ḵî·yō·wṯ ha·ḥem·dāh
verses.literal: against every ship of Tarshish and against every stately vessel

verses.original: וְשַׁח֙ גַּבְה֣וּת הָאָדָ֔ם וְשָׁפֵ֖ל ר֣וּם אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וְנִשְׂגַּ֧ב יְהוָ֛ה לְבַדּ֖וֹ בַּיּ֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šaḥ gaḇ·hūṯ hā·’ā·ḏām wə·šā·p̄êl rūm ’ă·nā·šîm wə·niś·gaḇ Yah·weh lə·ḇad·dōw bay·yō·wm ha·hū
verses.literal: So the pride of man will be brought low and the loftiness of men will be humbled the LORD alone will be exalted in that day

verses.original: וְהָאֱלִילִ֖ים כָּלִ֥יל יַחֲלֹֽף׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·’ĕ·lî·lîm kā·lîl ya·ḥă·lōp̄
verses.literal: and the idols will vanish completely

verses.original: וּבָ֙אוּ֙ בִּמְעָר֣וֹת צֻרִ֔ים וּבִמְחִלּ֖וֹת עָפָ֑ר מִפְּנֵ֞י פַּ֤חַד יְהוָה֙ וּמֵהֲדַ֣ר גְּאוֹנ֔וֹ בְּקוּמ֖וֹ לַעֲרֹ֥ץ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇā·’ū bim·‘ā·rō·wṯ ṣu·rîm ū·ḇim·ḥil·lō·wṯ ‘ā·p̄ār mip·pə·nê pa·ḥaḏ Yah·weh ū·mê·hă·ḏar gə·’ō·w·nōw bə·qū·mōw la·‘ă·rōṣ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: Men will flee to caves in the rocks and holes in the ground away from the terror of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty when He rises to shake the earth

verses.original: בַּיּ֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ יַשְׁלִ֣יךְ הָאָדָ֔ם אֵ֚ת אֱלִילֵ֣י כַסְפּ֔וֹ וְאֵ֖ת אֱלִילֵ֣י זְהָב֑וֹ אֲשֶׁ֤ר עָֽשׂוּ־ לוֹ֙ לְהִֽשְׁתַּחֲוֺ֔ת לַחְפֹּ֥ר פֵּר֖וֹת וְלָעֲטַלֵּפִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: bay·yō·wm ha·hū yaš·lîḵ hā·’ā·ḏām ’êṯ ’ĕ·lî·lê ḵas·pōw wə·’êṯ ’ĕ·lî·lê zə·hā·ḇōw ’ă·šer ‘ā·śū- lōw lə·hiš·ta·ḥă·wōṯ laḥ·pōr pê·rō·wṯ wə·lā·‘ă·ṭal·lê·p̄îm
verses.literal: In that day men will cast away to the moles . . . and bats their idols of silver and . . . gold the idols they made to worship

verses.original: לָבוֹא֙ בְּנִקְר֣וֹת הַצֻּרִ֔ים וּבִסְעִפֵ֖י הַסְּלָעִ֑ים מִפְּנֵ֞י פַּ֤חַד יְהוָה֙ וּמֵהֲדַ֣ר גְּאוֹנ֔וֹ בְּקוּמ֖וֹ לַעֲרֹ֥ץ הָאָֽרֶץ׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḇō·w bə·niq·rō·wṯ haṣ·ṣu·rîm ū·ḇis·‘i·p̄ê has·sə·lā·‘îm mip·pə·nê pa·ḥaḏ Yah·weh ū·mê·hă·ḏar gə·’ō·w·nōw bə·qū·mōw la·‘ă·rōṣ hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: They will flee to caverns in the rocks and crevices in the cliffs away from the terror of the LORD and from the splendor of His majesty when He rises to shake the earth

verses.original: חִדְל֤וּ לָכֶם֙ מִן־ הָ֣אָדָ֔ם אֲשֶׁ֥ר נְשָׁמָ֖ה בְּאַפּ֑וֹ כִּֽי־ בַמֶּ֥ה נֶחְשָׁ֖ב הֽוּא׃פ
verses.transliteration: ḥiḏ·lū lā·ḵem min- hā·’ā·ḏām ’ă·šer nə·šā·māh bə·’ap·pōw kî- ḇam·meh neḥ·šāḇ hū
verses.literal: Put no more trust in man who has only the breath in his nostrils . . . Of what account is he
